integrity: Proof supplies complete quantifiers, support-function variation, local boundary measure estimate, approximation and sharpness witnesses. Finite program checks are illustrative, not proofs. No independent certification asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exponent is sharp but the supplied positive-power and negative-power multiplicative constants are admissible, not claimed best. Planar convex bodies only, with origin-fixed weights; no general higher-dimensional or nonconvex statement. An unindexed equivalent theorem remains possible.
title: Sharp Hausdorff regularity exponents of planar radial weighted perimeters
